name: File defaults by type
description: Adds file types with default files on a File field.
project_description:
The File Defaults by Type module enhances file field management by allowing administrators to define multiple "types", identified by a label and with a default file assigned.

 This module is especially useful when used together with collaborative tools such as Collabora Online . Default "template" files can be defined for each type (e.g "Text", "Spreadsheet") and used as starting point for collaborative editing.

 Features 
 
 Type definition : for each file field, allows to define a series of "types", identified with a label. Each type requires a default file to be attached. 
 Default file widget : presents the user with a dropdown containing the types defined for that field instance. The user can choose one of them and attach it to the field. 
 UI module : file_defaults_by_type_ui enhances the configuration experience through a page where users can set or replace files. 
 
 Upcoming development / ideas 
 
 Add a new widget or modify the default file one so that a user can upload a custom fil, in addition to choosing one of the defaults provided. 
 Allow to rename the default file being attached.
